root.name: J.B.ハント・トランスポート・サービシズ

rows.ja: 鉄道の提携先・供給元
荷主(相手の資料に記載)
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 1989年に始めた鉄道・トラックの複合輸送の提携相手。輸送の大半はBNSFとNorfolk Southernに載る
relations.text_en: Intermodal partner since 1989; most of its intermodal freight moves on BNSF and Norfolk Southern

source.label: J.B. Hunt 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our JBI segment began operations in 1989, forming a unique partnership with what is now the BNSF Railway Company (BNSF); this was a watershed event in the industry and the first agreement that linked major rail and truckload carriers in a joint service environment.

companies.name: ノーフォーク・サザン

relations.text: 複合輸送の大半を運ぶ鉄道の一つ
relations.text_en: One of the railroads carrying most of its intermodal business

source.label: J.B. Hunt 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: While we have agreements with a number of Class I railroads, the majority of our business travels on the BNSF and the Norfolk Southern railways.

relations.text: Wabashが10-Kで、トレーラーを納める大口顧客の長距離トラック会社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Wabash lists it among large truckload carrier customers for its trailers

source.label: Wabash 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Truckload Carriers: Crete Carrier Corp.; J.B. Hunt Transport, Inc.; Werner Enterprises, Inc.

relations.text: Kodiak AIがS-1で、一緒に取り組む米国最大級の車両運用会社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Kodiak AI names it among the largest US fleets it works with

source.label: Kodiak AI S-1(2026年5月)
source.quote: Additionally, we work with some of the largest fleets in the United States, including J.B. Hunt, Werner Enterprises, C.R. England and Martin Brower.

companies.name: ジェームズ・ハーディー

relations.text: James Hardieが10-Kで、北米の貨物輸送に4,050万ドルを払ったと記載(2026年3月期、取締役の兼任あり)
relations.text_en: James Hardie paid it $40.5 million for North American freight (FY ended Mar 2026; the companies share a director)

source.label: James Hardie 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: For fiscal years ended March 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024, the Company paid $ 40.5 million, $ 38.0 million and $ 36.6 million, respectively, to JB Hunt for freight services in North America.

relations.text: RXOが10-Kで、主な競合の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: RXO lists it among its primary competitors

source.label: RXO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include C.H. Robinson, Echo Global Logistics, Expeditors, Forward Air, Flexport, J.B. Hunt, Landstar System, Total Quality Logistics, and Uber Freight.

relations.text: Matsonが10-Kで、物流仲介の競合となる大手として挙げる
relations.text_en: Matson names it an asset-invested leader competing with its logistics brokerage

source.label: Matson 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Matson Logistics' Transportation Brokerage services compete most directly with C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Hub Group, RXO and other freight brokers and intermodal marketing companies, and asset-invested market leaders such as J.B. Hunt.

companies.name: フレイト・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Freight Technologiesが20-Fで、米墨国境輸送の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Freight Technologies names it a cross-border trucking competitor

source.label: Freight Technologies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Asset-based carriers with cross-border operations, including J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc., Schneider National, Inc., Werner Enterprises, Inc., Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings Inc.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
